scope: Printed-page/locator inspection only, not full-page transcription or a claim to have read every neighboring entry. The 16 initial contact sheets cover the first 190 cited scans; the final Lincoln sheet verifies the four later corrected civil locators as well as the other Lincoln pages. OR I IV p566 was additionally inspected in full because its number lies low on the page. The six later Seven Pines report pages were all viewed directly as full images; their factual passages were also checked. Selected factual body/column checks are recorded separately in image-checks.json.
